# Interface: GasGridQuery

Read-only logical-cell access to the input snapshot of the current solver stage. GPU only.

## Methods

<a id="getcell"></a>

### getCell()

```ts
getCell(
   x,
   y,
   z
): Readonly<GPUGasCell>;
```

Missing/nonresident/out-of-range cells return zero state. Never writes neighbor storage.
